globalProperty.value: select distinct concat(pn.given_name," ", ifnull(pn.family_name,'')) as name, pi.identifier as identifier, concat("",p.uuid) as uuid from visit v join person_name pn on v.patient_id = pn.person_id and pn.voided = 0 and pn.preferred = 1 join patient_identifier pi on v.patient_id = pi.patient_id and pi.voided=0 join patient_identifier_type pit on pi.identifier_type = pit.patient_identifier_type_id join global_property gp on gp.property="bahmni.primaryIdentifierType" and gp.property_value=pit.uuid join person p on p.person_id = v.patient_id and p.voided=0 join encounter en on en.visit_id = v.visit_id and en.voided=0 left outer join location loc on en.location_id = loc.location_id and loc.retired = 0 join location_attribute la on loc.location_id = la.location_id and la.voided = 0 join location_attribute_type lat on la.attribute_type_id = lat.location_attribute_type_id and lat.name = 'Customer Code' and lat.retired = 0 join person_attribute pa on p.person_id = pa.person_id and pa.voided = 0 join person_attribute_type pat on pa.person_attribute_type_id = pat.person_attribute_type_id and pat.name = 'Company Code' and pat.retired = 0 join orders ord on ord.patient_id = v.patient_id and ord.voided = 0 join order_type ot on ord.order_type_id = ot.order_type_id and ot.name = "Lab Order" where v.voided = 0 and loc.uuid=${location_uuid} and la.value_reference is not null and la.value_reference != '' and pa.value = la.value_reference and (ord.fulfiller_status is null or ord.fulfiller_status != 'COMPLETED' or v.date_stopped is null) order by en.encounter_datetime desc;
globalProperty.description: SQL query to get list of patients with laborders for a login location
